title: PLOS Biology and its Editorial Processes
summary: This cluster revolves around PLOS Biology, a scientific journal that oversees the work of several editors and authors. Mark Siegal serves as an Academic Editor, while Roland G Roberts is the Senior Editor. The journal permits the use of the Creative Commons Attribution License. Authors such as Sonal have submitted manuscripts to PLOS Biology. The journal is also used by the Editorial Manager system. Additionally, the cluster includes various organisms and a chemical, including budding yeast, which is produced by hydrogen sulfide gas.
